mutants.name: r6_02_student_t_chi_square_twice_the_degrees.py

mutants.name: r6_03_pivot_tolerance_rejects_small_positive_variance.py

mutants.description: Verifier round-5 student-error mutant. The 99% index is round(0.99 n), not its ceiling.

mutants.name: v7_01_chi_square_drawn_per_position.py
mutants.description: Verifier round-3 student-error mutant (v7). Student-t draws one chi-square variable per position, not one per draw, so the assets of a draw get different scales.
